Question: Assalam wale kum Meri umar 26 saal hai,mujhe is umar mein kai beemariyan ho gayee hain jaise ki thyroid ki problem,High Chloesterol ki problem, Aur mein mentally bhi bahut pareshaan rehta hoon aur aksar mere dil mein ye khyal aata hai ki mujhe aur bhi kai beemariyan ho gayi hain,mere dimag mein dar baith gaya hai,koi aisa wajeefa batain ki saree mushkilen allah rabbulijjat door kar de. Answer ID: 8940 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1142/1142=M/1429) May Allah cure you from every disease, amen! You should consult any expert physician. Be mindful of five time prayers, recite Surah Fatihah 41 times on water daily and drink it. Recite Surah Al-Kafiroon, Surah Al-Ikhlas, Surah Al-Falaq, Surah Al-Naas with Ayatul Kursi and blow on your entire body after every obligatory salah . Also, you should read durood as much as you can . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
